messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — running a cross-model microbench that forces the same tokenization + decode params across runtime variants. Need input on batching knobs and KV sticky behavior.
jon: What's the exact setup? seed, prompts, stop sequences?
maria: Using replay harness from prod-chat (sanitized). Synthetic tail generator for long contexts. Models: rdx-6b-q4, rdx-6b-fp16, rdx-7b-int8. Will pin model checkpoints and use identical decode params: temp=0.0, top_p=0.95, max_new_tokens=128, stop=["\n\n"].
lee: Tokenizer alignment is crucial — we'll canonicalize via the same tokenizer binary. Suggest run:
```
# deterministic tokenize
ids = tokenizer.encode(prompt, add_special_tokens=False)
```
and store ids with the replay events.
sasha: For batching heuristics, test 3 profiles: latency-opt (max_batch=8, batch_timeout=8ms), throughput (max_batch=64, timeout=25ms), and adaptive (SLO=150ms with immediate flush). Run with KV cache on/off; measure warm vs cold cache.
jon: How do we ensure output parity? lock RNG seed where applicable, compare detokenized outputs, and enforce same stop-sequence handling (trim by token-level stop match). Use a canonical detokenizer to compare strings.
maria: Load plan: steady-state 20 RPS for baseline (10k requests), then 30s burst to 200 RPS repeated 10x. Also run single-request microbench (1000 single-shot) to measure tail latency.
dev-bot: bench-run: started job bench-2945678901 — logs at https://ci.internal/bench/bench-2945678901
lee: Instrumentation checklist: per-request fields: kernel_choice, kernel_version, decode_time_ms, batch_fill_wait_ms, kv_hit_ratio, kernel_switch_count. Emit traces to jaeger and aggregate histograms.
sasha: If we hit regressions, likely culprits: tokenizer mismatch -> kernel fallback to generic ops -> quantization fallback. Also watch for excessive kernel switching when batch shapes vary.
maria: I'll push the token-id normalized replay and kick off runs today. If you have prompt subsets to add, drop them in /shared/bench/prompts/fair_microset_v2.json. Will post a short summary + perf table when runs finish.
jon: :thumbsup:
